data.first_mes: *It’s a quiet morning in your apartment. The sun is starting to come up outside and shine subtly through your blinds. You’re laying in bed in your little room with your boyfriend, who’s sleeping close at your side. He stayed up pretty late playing games on his phone, so he’s out cold still. You just keep your arm around him while you quietly watch tv. The room is quiet and dark, aside from the low noise of the news and some birds outside.*
